meta.applyDescription: Apply to the office with your team to prepare for a TEKNOFEST competition — no account needed.

copy.copiedHint: The link was copied to the clipboard. Keep it somewhere safe.
copy.hint: Save the link: notes, a browser bookmark or a message to yourself.
copy.manual: Automatic copying does not work on this connection. The link is selected — copy it manually (Ctrl+C, or long-press and choose "Copy").

form.title: Competition preparation request
form.description: Without creating an account, the team captain picks the competition and sub-category, lists the team members and sends the request to the office. A coordinator reviews it — people decide, not the system.

how.title: How it works
how.s1: Fill in and send the form — about 5 minutes.
how.s2: You get a request code and a private tracking link. No e-mails are sent, so save the link.
how.s3: A coordinator reviews it and may accept it, ask for changes or reject it with a reason. The status shows on your link.

form.lookupCta: Already applied? Check the status by code
form.unavailableTitle: The request form is not available right now
form.unavailableBody: The competition catalog or the list of universities has not been loaded yet. Please try again later.

sections.competitionHint: Pick the competition from the TEKNOFEST catalog that your team wants to enter.
sections.membersHint: The captain is on the first row. You can list up to {max} people, captain included.
sections.ideaHint: Describe what you want to build and what support you expect from the office.

form.searchHint: Filters by competition or sub-category name.
form.competitionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No matching competition — change the search} one {Showing # of {total} competitions} other {Showing # of {total} competitions}}
form.notTracked: Not tracked by the office yet
form.trackedHint: The office tracks the 2027 rules of this competition.
form.notTrackedHint: The office does not track the 2027 rules of this competition yet. That does not block your request — the coordinator can start tracking when accepting it.
form.subcategoryHint: This competition has sub-categories — pick one.
form.teamNameHint: The name your team will use in the competition.
form.noFaculties: No faculties are registered for this university.
form.captainHint: The captain is the office’s contact person. If you lose the link, the status can be checked with the code and the captain’s e-mail.
form.maxReached: Up to {max} people (captain included) can be listed.
form.ideaHint: Briefly describe the problem and your solution ({ideaMin}–{ideaMax} characters).
form.consent: I confirm that the team members know about this request and that the data will be used only by the office for the preparation programme.
form.consentHint: Names and e-mails are visible only to Academy coordinators. They are copied to the student and team registry only if the request is accepted.
form.linkNotice: After sending, a request code and a private tracking link will be shown. No e-mails are sent — save the link right away.

errors.ideaLong: The idea cannot be longer than {ideaMax} characters.

errors.lookupLimited: Too many checks from this connection. Try again in a few minutes.

success.title: Your request has been sent
success.body: The office has received your request. The status on your tracking link updates as the coordinator reviews it.
success.saveBody: No e-mails are sent. This link is the only way to track, edit or withdraw the request. Keep it somewhere safe and do not share it outside the team.
success.lostHint: If you lose the link, you can check the status with the code and the captain’s e-mail — view only.

status.description: This page is open only to people who have the link. It shows the status, the coordinator’s notes and what you sent.

info.SUBMITTED: Your request has reached the office and is waiting for a coordinator. Until the review starts you can edit or withdraw it.
info.UNDER_REVIEW: A coordinator is reviewing your request. Editing and withdrawing are not possible meanwhile; the decision will appear on this page.
info.NEEDS_CHANGES: The coordinator asked for changes. Read the note, edit the request and send it again.
info.ACCEPTED: Your request was accepted. The team and the next steps are shown below.
info.REJECTED: The request was rejected. If things change, you can send a new request.
info.WITHDRAWN: The team withdrew the request. You can send a new request if needed.

note.NEEDS_CHANGES: Coordinator’s note on what to change

status.locked: The request cannot be changed while a coordinator is reviewing it.
status.withdrawBody: A withdrawn request cannot be restored and the coordinator will not review it. You can send a new request later if needed.
status.updated: The request was updated and sent again
status.linkHint: The link is a secret key: save it and share it only with your team members.
status.editDescription: Make your changes and send the request again. It goes back to "Submitted" and the coordinator reviews it again.

history.title: Status history
history.UNDER_REVIEW: Taken into review by a coordinator

accepted.title: Your team is active in the Academy
accepted.body: The coordinator accepted your request and added your team to the Academy’s active teams.
accepted.teamGone: The team record is no longer active in the Academy. Contact the office for details.
accepted.n1: The coordinator will contact the captain to arrange a first meeting.
accepted.n2: Follow the Academy trainings and announcements and build a work plan with your mentor.
accepted.n3: Check the 2027 rules and deadlines on the official competition page. The TÜRKTECH 50 programme application is created separately by the coordinator.

lookup.title: Check status by code
lookup.description: If you lost the tracking link, you can see the status with the request code and the captain’s e-mail.
lookup.readOnly: View only: members, coordinator notes, editing and withdrawing are available only through the private tracking link.
lookup.lostLink: The link cannot be re-sent or recovered. If you need to edit the request, contact the office with your request code.

notFound.title: Link not found
notFound.body: The link is wrong or incomplete, or there is no such request. Check that you copied the whole link.
